title: 坡上有一格
subject: a Kazakh herder at the winter pasture who climbs the slope behind the house at nine every night for one bar of signal to call his wife in town
caption: Solo nylon-string steppe folk in the Kazakh style of Mamer's solo recordings, sung in Mandarin. One fingerpicked nylon-string guitar, played loosely and often rubato, with the open low strings droning under the melody; dombra-style strummed triplet figures on the same guitar between sung lines; knuckle taps on the guitar body as the only percussion; wordless humming over the strums in the interlude. Close, dry and intimate like one man in a small room, the guitar and the voice forward, breaths audible. Male voice, low, gentle and contemplative, with small steppe-style ornaments on held notes. 76 BPM, E minor. Tender, cold and happily married. No drums, no full band, no strummed steel-string city folk, no morin khuur, no gallop rhythm, no autotune.
lyrics:
[Intro - four bars, fingerpicked nylon guitar over an open low drone, knuckle taps]

[Verse 1]
晚上九點 我把爐子裡的火捅旺一點
披上那件羊皮大衣 往屋後的坡上走
狗跟在後面 雪埋到膝蓋
走到那塊黑石頭 手機才有一格

[Chorus]
喂 我在坡上 有一格
妳先說 妳先說 我這邊風大
說兒子考了第幾名 說縣城下雪沒有
說什麼都好 我在聽

[Interlude - wordless humming over dombra-style strummed triplets]

[Verse 2]
我說今天又生了兩隻小羊 一黑一白
黑的那隻站不起來 我抱進屋裡 放在爐子邊
妳笑我 說我對羊比對妳還好
風把妳的笑 吹斷了一半

[Chorus]
喂 我在坡上 還有一格
妳再說一次 妳再說一次 我這邊風大
妳說等開春 帶兒子上山來看我
我說好 黑的那隻 我留給他

[Outro - guitar alone, rubato, one knuckle tap]
下坡的時候 訊號沒了
我還是對著手機 把那句話說完了
